title.zh: AtomISA — AOD 原子运动可视化

summary.zh: 基于浏览器的交互式模拟器，用于 AOD 原子运动（AAM）模型——中性原子量子计算平台中的原子重排过程。纯 HTML + JavaScript，无需依赖。
summary.en: Interactive browser-based simulator for AOD Atom Motion (AAM), a model of atom rearrangement in neutral-atom quantum computing platforms. Visualises pickup, motion, and offload phases with real-time canvas animation. Pure HTML + JavaScript, no dependencies.

summary.zh: 基于格手术的门传输模拟，包含线路级噪声模拟与态矢量分析。
summary.en: Simulation of surgery-based gate teleportation, including circuit-level noise simulation and state-vector analysis.

page_en.title: Simulation of surgery-based gate teleportation
metas: Includes circuit-level noise simulation using [Stim](https://github.com/quantumlib/Stim) and a state-vector analysis of using S gates as a proxy for T gates.

summary.zh: 物理层魔态提纯态矢量模拟。
summary.en: State-vector simulation for physical-level magic state distillation.

page_en.title: Physical-level magic state distillation simulation
metas: State-vector simulation for magic state distillation at the physical level.

summary.zh: 包括 hetvid、ega-numbering、fig-plucker 等模板与包。
summary.en: Includes hetvid, ega-numbering, fig-plucker, and related writing/plotting tools.

page_en.title: hetvid
metas: A Typst template for light-weighted notes. Current version: 0.2.0.
